item.description:

・Fixed an issue where terrain, building, and other textures could load at significantly reduced resolution for some players

item.title: Apex Legends™: Marked Midseason Patch Notes
item.description:
INTRO

Welcome back to Split 2 of Apex Legends: Marked. To start the second half of the season, we’ve got Legend balancing changes, some adjustment to loot availability (including more healing items), buffs to a trio of long range weapons, and the usual array of tweaks, fixes and adjustments. Split 2 starts on September 15th, so assemble your squad and get ready to jump back into Marked!

ANTI CHEAT UPDATE

item.title: World of Trucks: Resuming Events
item.description:
Our dearest community,

Earlier this year, we shared that we would be taking a temporary pause from running our World of Trucks events. We also know how much these events mean to our #BestCommunityEver and that many of you have missed taking part. Today, we are pleased to confirm that we have decided to resume our World of Trucks events in the familiar format you already know, while the wider rework continues.
